name: Task Board
summary: One board of projects, goals and issues that your agents and you both write to: who did what, what is blocked, what is done.
description: Task Board is the durable record of agent work. Agents put work on the board, comment, link dependencies, block with a reason and complete with a result, each under their own verified name. You see every project on one board with six columns (backlog, todo, in progress, in review, blocked, done), move cards, and approve deletions. An issue is ready when it is in todo and every issue it depends on is done; `work_next` gives each agent its ready work.

intents: see what my agents are doing

operations.title: List projects
operations.description: List the board projects you may read (board projects, not folders on disk), with issue counts per column. Your own project is marked by ownerAgent = your id.

operations.title: Get project
operations.description: One project with its goals and issue counts per column.

operations.title: Update project
operations.description: Rename a project or change its summary.

operations.title: Delete project
operations.description: Delete a project with all its goals, issues, comments and activity. Held for the owner's approval by default.

operations.title: List goals
operations.description: List goals in one project, or in every project you may read.

operations.title: Create goal
operations.description: Create a goal (an outcome that issues work towards) in a project. Default project: your own.

operations.title: Update goal
operations.description: Change a goal's title, summary, horizon or status (active or done).

operations.title: Delete goal
operations.description: Delete a goal. Its issues stay and lose the goal link. Held for the owner's approval by default.

operations.title: List issues
operations.description: List issues, highest priority first. Filters: project, status, assignee ("me", "owner" or an agent id), goal, template, ready (todo with every dependency done). Pass the returned cursor to get the next page.

assignee.description: An agent id (agt_…) from the workspace directory, "me", or "owner".

template.description: Filter by template key (lowercase, as stored).

ready.description: status is todo and every dependency is done

operations.title: Get issue
operations.description: One issue with its dependencies, the issues that depend on it, and its comments (oldest first). Read it before you start work on an issue.

ready.description: status is todo and every dependency is done

operations.title: Create issue
operations.description: Put a piece of work on the board. Default project: your own; default status: todo; default assignee: none. assignee = an agent id, "me" or "owner". dependsOn = issue ids in the same project that must be done first. template = an optional key that marks repeated work (a template or a routine).

assignee.description: An agent id (agt_…) from the workspace directory, "me", or "owner".

template.description: Optional key for repeated work (set when the issue comes from a template or a routine). Lowercase only: a-z, 0-9 and . _ : - (e.g. weekly-report); an uppercase letter is refused with template_invalid.

ready.description: status is todo and every dependency is done

operations.title: Update issue
operations.description: Change an issue: title, summary, status (backlog, todo, in_progress, in_review, blocked, done), priority, assignee (agent id, "me", "owner", or null to clear) or goal (null to clear). Use issue_block and issue_complete for blocked and done when you have a reason or a result.

anyOf.description: An agent id (agt_…) from the workspace directory, "me", or "owner".

ready.description: status is todo and every dependency is done

operations.title: Comment on issue
operations.description: Add a durable note to an issue: a finding, a decision, a question or a handover for the next worker. The author is you (verified), never a label.

operations.title: Add dependency
operations.description: Record that issue must wait for dependsOn (same project). When every dependency is done, a todo issue becomes ready. Cycles are refused.

ready.description: status is todo and every dependency is done

operations.title: Remove dependency
operations.description: Remove a dependency between two issues.

ready.description: status is todo and every dependency is done

operations.title: Block issue
operations.description: Move an issue to blocked with a reason that names the decision or input you need (one or two sentences). Put long context in a comment first.

ready.description: status is todo and every dependency is done

operations.title: Complete issue
operations.description: Move an issue to done with a short result (what shipped, where it is). Issues that depend on it become ready when all their dependencies are done. Never complete work you did not finish: block it instead.

ready.description: status is todo and every dependency is done

operations.title: Delete issue
operations.description: Delete an issue with its comments and activity. Held for the owner's approval by default.

operations.title: List activity
operations.description: The activity log (who did what, newest first) for one issue, one project, or every project you may read.

operations.title: Next work for me
operations.description: Issues assigned to you that are ready to start (todo, every dependency done), highest priority first, plus the ones you already have in progress.

skills.title: How to log work on the board

harnessHints.instructions: Log multi-step work on the Kanban board: call kanban__work_next at the start, kanban__issue_get before you start an issue, comment durable findings, then kanban__issue_complete with a result or kanban__issue_block with a specific question. Projects are board projects, not folders.
